purpose: Freeze, append-only, the HPO R2 decision that repairs the hosted baseline provisioning prerequisites: (D1) split managed-role IDENTITY creation out of stella_hosted_0001 into ONE new pre-baseline prepared unit; (D2) keep stella_hosted_0001 post-baseline as a consumer/verifier of those identities plus its existing ownership/grant bootstrap; (D3) keep 0042/0045 byte-identical inside PHASE_BASELINE; (D4) make 0044's stella_suggestion_decisions no-truncate trigger conditional on the relation existing; (D5) prove the corrected sequence on a DISPOSABLE ISOLATED PostgreSQL cluster. This artifact authorizes exactly the protected mutations listed below and nothing else. It integrates no product slice and does not reopen the audited 123-file B1 integration.
scope_note: APPEND-ONLY AUTHORITY. Does not rewrite, supersede, reinterpret or restate docs/ops/ods/ODS_V1_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json, ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.1/1.0.2/1.0.3, ODS_V1_OPERATIONAL_CLOSURE_v1.0.0.json, ODS_V1_EFFICIENCY_VALIDATION_v1.0.0.json, or any FIB / PC-01B / IM-01B artifact. §0 E2 — current_user is NOT a superuser (platform only)
§0 E3 — current_user holds CREATEROLE (platform only; the CREATE-on-public half stays with the post-baseline package)
§0 E4 — uellix.bootstrap_environment must equal 'staging' in the same session
§2 — five literal CREATE ROLE / ALTER ROLE blocks: uellix_owner, uellix_migrator, uellix_app, uellix_writer, uellix_auditor
§2b — RR-02: GRANT uellix_owner TO postgres WITH INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE (when current_user = postgres) and the SET-reachability assertion
membership block — GRANT uellix_owner TO uellix_migrator WITH INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE; GRANT uellix_writer TO uellix_app WITH INHERIT TRUE, SET FALSE
§6 (1)(2)(3) — five roles exist with no dangerous attribute; uellix_app reaches neither owner nor migrator; migrator holds owner WITH SET TRUE, INHERIT FALSE
POST_BASELINE_SECTIONS: §0 E5 / E5b — RLS helpers current_user_org_ids(), current_user_is_super_admin() and their owner's reach to auth.uid()
§0 E5c — installer reach to auth.uid() (kept post-baseline with the shim it protects)
§2b-bis — GRANT USAGE/CREATE ON SCHEMA public (bootstrap surface for §2c)
§2c — ALTER TABLE public.stella_interactions OWNER TO uellix_owner
ALTER SCHEMA uellix_bootstrap OWNER TO uellix_owner
FUNCTION_DEPENDENCIES: public.current_user_org_ids() (0031, ordinal 32; EXECUTE re-granted by 0039, ordinal 42)
MEMBERSHIP_DEPENDENCIES: uellix_owner → postgres (SET TRUE, INHERIT FALSE; RR-02, only when current_user = postgres)

D2_stella_hosted_0001_post_baseline.rollback: stella_hosted_0001_rollback.sql stops dropping the five roles (they belong to stella_hosted_0000); it still REVOKEs the schema-public privileges it granted and asserts the bootstrap schema and shim are gone; stella_hosted_0000_rollback.sql owns membership revocation and role removal, refusing while uellix_bootstrap exists or any role owns objects.

D3_baseline_0042_0045.note: They succeed because canonical uellix_app exists from PHASE_MANAGED_ROLE_IDENTITIES. Their CREATE POLICY … TO uellix_app semantics are not altered.

D4_migration_0044.correction: Wrap ONLY the stella_suggestion_decisions DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS / CREATE TRIGGER pair in a DO $$ block guarded by to_regclass('public.stella_suggestion_decisions') IS NOT NULL; when absent, RAISE NOTICE and skip that one trigger deterministically. The five other DROP/CREATE TRIGGER pairs remain unconditional and byte-identical. No CREATE TABLE. No change to uellix_forbid_mutation().
D4_migration_0044.static_consequences: baseline scanner counts 5 unconditional triggers for the unit (the guarded one lives inside a DO statement); baseline-manifest expect.triggersCreatedCount for 0044 becomes 5; B0-06 derives its expected trigger set from the scanner and therefore does not demand the conditional trigger on a table-absent baseline; tests/fib-audit-migrations.test.ts keeps its six-name inventory and its statement allowlist admits the guard tokens.
